channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block C
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block C (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: On six Mission Rock timelines the October 10, 2023 vote on…
item.description: On six Mission Rock timelines the October 10, 2023 vote on Resolution 23-46 is now shown as the date of the vote itself, not as a date a document showed it. Nothing else changed. Source: Port Commission minutes, October 10, 2023, p. 37 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline): 'Resolution 23-46 passed unanimously as amended.'.
item.source: Port Commission minutes, October 10, 2023, p. 37 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline): 'Resolution 23-46 passed unanimously as amended.'

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: The Port's June 2026 memo funds Phase 2 pre-development costs…
item.description: The Port's June 2026 memo funds Phase 2 pre-development costs, including infrastructure design; vertical-building design is described as a separate, parallel Developer effort. The memo does not name Block C. The Development Agreement's effective date is given as August 15, 2018. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf ; https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2021-07/Mission%20Rock%20Fact%20Sheet_24June2021.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/project/mission-rock.

item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: The summary for Mission Rock Block C now includes Port's June…
item.description: The summary for Mission Rock Block C now includes Port's June 2026 Phase 2 pre-development item. Source: https://www.sfport.com/media/11337/download?inline.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: Block C's note no longer says the Port describes it as a…
item.description: Block C's note no longer says the Port describes it as a surface parking lot; the Port's June 2026 memo uses that phrase as a goal for the whole project. It says only that Phase 2 is positioned to begin construction as early as 2027, an expected start. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: Block C's record and map shape now say: the base building…
item.description: Block C's record and map shape now say: the base building maximum is 90 ft on one side and 60 ft on the other (there is no 60-ft minimum base height); the adopted document is the Mission Rock Design Controls dated April 24, 2018 (not 'D4D-adopted', and Mission Rock Partners is not named in it); 'unbuilt' and 'surface parking' are attributed to the Port's June 2026 Phase 2 update; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note (Block A is 3.3% off); the Jan 30, 2018 approvals, Oct 10, 2023 Resolution 23-46, March 11, 2025 Resolution 25-17 and June 9, 2026 Resolution 26-34 now cite the Port Commission minutes; 'Resolution 33-18' is qualified; and the citations for the 2012 Revised Proposal and the Design Controls were corrected. The shape itself is unchanged. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); San Francisco Giants with The Cordish Companies, Mission Rock Design + Development Revised Proposal, 2012-03 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2022-01/D4D%20-%20MissionRockMarch12RevProposalDesign.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download), 2023-10-10 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline), 2025-03-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10376/download?inline), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11337/download?inline).

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block C: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03…
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sep 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34… (Jun 9, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (for eligible Phase 2 pre-development costs, including 'design and engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure; Developer, Port, and City staff costs; consultant expenses'; the memo separately says the Developer will advance pre-development and design work for the vertical buildings in parallel), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule lists a 'Potential Construction Start' of Summer/Fall 2027 for horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction, and the memo says Phase 2 could begin construction 'as early as 2027' once anchor tenants are secured; its Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical start – not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block. (Jun 9, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher… (Mar 11, 2025)
item.description: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-11

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block C: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed… (Oct 10, 2023)
item.description: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal… (Dec 28, 2022)
item.description: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Development Agreement takes effect (the Port's… (Aug 15, 2018)
item.description: Development Agreement takes effect (the Port's fact sheet gives its effective date as Aug. 15, 2018; SF Planning's project page dates both the Development Agreement and the Disposition and Development Agreement 8/15/2018); DA term 30 years, four phases (Aug 15, 2018). Source: SF Planning; Port of San Francisco, 2021-06-24.
item.source: SF Planning; Port of San Francisco, 2021-06-24

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Board of Supervisors affirms the EIR certification… (Mar 6, 2018)
item.description: Board of Supervisors affirms the EIR certification and approvals (File No. 171286 per the Notice of Determination; the Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance); Notice of Determination filed March 9, 2018 (Mar 6, 2018). Source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05.
item.source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock DDA and… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock DDA and Design Controls that set this block's use and envelope (among Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10, which the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record as adopted) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2018-01-30; Port of San Francisco, 2018-01-26; Port of San Francisco, 2018-04-24.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2018-01-30; Port of San Francisco, 2018-01-26; Port of San Francisco, 2018-04-24

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block C: Draft EIR's illustrative phasing (developer's 2015… (~Apr 2017)
item.description: Draft EIR's illustrative phasing (developer's 2015 estimate) placed Block C in Area 2 with Blocks B and D, 2018-2021; later Port reports list a different phasing (the Oct 2023 memo, Table 2, lists Phase 1 as Parcels A, B, F and G) (~Apr 2017). Source: SF Planning, 2017-04; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.
